move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.
Please let me explain.
We welcome the 14-day payment terms, which we accept in exchange for a price reduction.
To keep the unit price as low as possible, we must revert the delivery term to EXW, as DAP adds substantial freight costs.
Regarding your volume commitment, please provide the historical consumption data or firm forecasts so we can factor this into our calculation.
Alternatively, with delivery EXW: €16.50 per unit.
Which volume can you commit to?
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
